blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top- k k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page.
Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.
blocks.zh:
远景-语言模型(VLMs)越来越多地用于长文件处理,其中的输入将文本与图表,图表,数字,以及复杂的布局相结合. 部署它们意味着选择如何将文档输入模型,当只发送一个子集的页面时,该模型将检索器使用,是用代理方式运行模型还是作为静态管道运行. 我们用两个长文件质量评估基准来研究这些选择,这些基准既有前沿API,也有开放式VLM。 首先,在MMLong Bench-Doc上,我们的6个工具代理,带有页面,表,图,搜索的呼叫只有在回答VLM足够大时才会得到回报:使用Quen3.5-4B和9B会跟踪静态页面输入,其中Quen3.5-27B会绘制关卡,而Sonnet 4.5会引导. 在LongDocURL上,它与每个读取器的静态输入或比静态输入还早。 它在最坚固的静态管道上的引力与MMLong Bench-Doc上的前沿阅读器最为清晰,并缩小到LongDocURL上的噪音范围. 其次,检索方式比特定的检索器更重要:最强图像检索器领导最强文本管道,在文本侧则有一个现成的交叉编码器重新排位,本质上与重得多的多级LLM管道匹配. Top -k k 图像检索也是我们配对的每个阅读器中最有符号效率的输入,大约是发送每页的符号的七到四分之一.
第三,跨越所有三个选择,我们三个最强的管道在不同的问题上取得成功,一个选择每个问题最好的管道的神谕比最好的单一管道获得大约13分,尽管证据类型的路线几乎没有恢复。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) Liu et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024) ; Bai et al. (2025) are becoming the standard choice for long-document processing. Real-world long documents such as financial filings, official reports, and scientific papers span tens to hundreds of pages, interleaving prose with charts, tables, and figures under inconsistent layout. Answering a single question can require locating the right page, interpreting a specific chart or table, and combining evidence scattered across several pages. Short-context benchmarks Mathew et al. (2021) ; Masry et al. (2022) rarely test these skills together.
blocks.zh: 远景-语言模型 刘等人(2023年);王等人(2024年);白等人(2025年)成为长文件处理的标准选择. 真实世界的长文件,如财务申报、正式报告和科学文件长达数十至数百页,与图表和数字相互交织,布局不一致。 回答一个问题可能需要找到正确的页面,解释具体的图表或表格,并综合分散在几页的证据。 短文基准 Mathew等人(2021年);Masry等人(2022年)很少一起测试这些技能.

blocks.en: Three architectural decisions shape a production long-document QA pipeline: the input modality in which the document reaches the VLM, the retriever that selects pages when only a subset is sent, and whether the model works agentically , choosing pages, figures, or tables at inference time via tool calls rather than reading a fixed input (§ 3 defines all three). Acting agentically can surface evidence a retriever would miss, at the cost of latency and complexity. Each axis has been studied on its own, but their joint behaviour, and the accuracy/cost trade-offs it implies, have not been measured at frontier-VLM scale.
blocks.zh: 三个建筑决定塑造一个生产长文件QA管道:文档到达VLM的输入方式,仅在发送子集时选择页面的检索器,以及模型工作是否代理性地通过工具调用而不是读取固定输入(§3定义了所有三个)来选择页面,在推断时选择页面,数字或表格. 代理行为可以表面显示一个检索器会错过的证据,而代价是延迟和复杂。 对每个轴线都进行了单独研究,但是它们的共同行为以及它意味着的准确性/成本权衡并没有按照前沿-甚低分辨率尺度来衡量。

blocks.en: In this work, we present an empirical study of these three aspects on two long-document QA benchmarks (MMLongBench-Doc Ma et al. (2024) and LongDocURL Deng et al. (2025) ). We sweep several input modalities, retrieval approaches spanning lexical, dense-text, vision late-interaction, and rerank families, and several document-agent designs, with Claude Sonnet 4.5 Anthropic (2025) served through a hosted API and Qwen3.5-{4B, 9B, 27B} Qwen Team (2026) served locally. All configurations we run are scored on the full benchmark under one evaluation pipeline, producing a comparable leaderboard. Our six-tool function-calling agent with Sonnet 4.5 is the highest-scoring configuration under the official scorer on both benchmarks; on MMLongBench-Doc it leads same-reader top-5 retrieval by + 11.7 +11.7 pp, and on LongDocURL it is level with the best retrieval pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了关于这两个长期文件质量评估基准(MMLong Bench-Doc Ma等人(2024年)和LongDocURL Deng等人(2025年))的经验性研究。 我们搜索了几种输入方式,检索方法包括词汇学、稠密文本、视觉晚交、重新排序的家庭,以及几种文档代理设计,克劳德·索内特4.5 Anthropic(2025年)通过托管的API和Qun3.5-{4B、9B、27B} Quen Team (2026)在当地服役. 我们运行的所有配置都在一个评价程序下在全部基准上得分,产生一个可比的领导板. 我们配有Sonnet 4.5的六工具函数调用代理器是两个基准上的官方计分器下的最高评分配置;在MMLong Bench-Doc上,它通过+11.7+11.7 pp引导同位读取器的上-5检索,在LongDocURL上,它是具有最佳检索管道的平面.

blocks.en: Our contribution is not any single pipeline; the function-calling agent is a standard design. It is the controlled joint study of all three axes on one comparable footing, together with a re-evaluation of the closest prior system under each benchmark’s official scorer rather than the more lenient LLM judges several such systems report against. That re-evaluation drops its judge-scored number by roughly 9 9 pp (§ 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献不是任何单一的管道;功能调用剂是一种标准设计。 这是在可比较的基础上对所有三个轴进行控制下的联合研究,同时对每个基准的官方计分器下最接近的先前系统进行重新评价,而不是对较宽松的LLM作出若干次这类系统的报告。 这种重新评价使法官评分减少大约9 9页(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Long-Document Multimodal QA
blocks.zh: 2.1 长文件

blocks.en: Document QA has scaled from single-page benchmarks Mathew et al. (2021) ; Mathew et al. (2022) ; Masry et al. (2022) ; Tanaka et al. (2021) to multi-page settings with moderate document length Tito et al. (2023) ; Tanaka et al. (2023) ; Van Landeghem et al. (2023) ; Dasigi et al. (2021) ; Lála et al. (2023) , and most recently to long, mixed-modality documents Chia et al. (2025) ; Islam et al. (2023) ; Xia et al. (2024) . In this work, we utilize two benchmarks at the long end of this progression. MMLongBench-Doc Ma et al. (2024) comprises 135 PDFs with 1,082 questions stratified by single-page versus cross-page evidence and by visual-element type (chart, table, figure, layout, text). LongDocURL Deng et al. (2025) comprises 396 long documents with 2,325 questions in its public split, organised along three tasks (Understanding, Reasoning, Locating) and four of the same evidence-element types (all but chart). We choose these two because they cover different parts of the space: MMLongBench-Doc is shorter but more visually varied, LongDocURL longer.

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 远景规划模式

blocks.en: Vision-language models integrate a visual encoder with a language model so a single network reasons over text and images together Liu et al. (2023) ; Qwen Team (2026) . Document-specific VLMs instead encode page structure: layout-aware models fuse text, position, and visual features but require a separate OCR step Xu et al. (2020) , OCR-free successors encode page images end-to-end Kim et al. (2022) , and high-resolution multi-page extensions compress each page’s visual tokens to keep long inputs tractable Hu et al. (2025) . These are typically evaluated at smaller context rather than on documents of tens to hundreds of pages, where access mode and retrieval also matter.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型将视觉编码器与语言模型融合在一起,因此在文字和图像上,刘等人(2023年);Quen Team(2026年)共同拥有单一的网络理由. 特定文件 VLMs转而编码页面结构:布局-意识型号的引信文本,位置,和视觉特征,但需要单独的OCR步骤Xu等人(2020年),OCR自由的继任者编码页面图像端到端的Kim等人. (2022年),和高分辨率多页扩展压缩每页的视觉符号,以保持长输入可牵引的Hu等人(2025年). 通常在较小的上下文中,而不是在几十至数百页的文件中加以评价,在这些文件中,访问模式和检索也很重要。

blocks.en: Frontier multimodal models, on the API side Anthropic (2025) ; Hurst et al. (2024) ; Team et al. (2024) and the open-weight side Qwen Team (2026) ; Chen et al. (2024b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2024) , accept page images directly and increasingly do well on long-document QA without document-specific architectures. Long-context modeling has been studied mostly on the text side Liu et al. (2025) , while evaluations on multimodal documents usually commit to a single access mode, whether all page images Ma et al. (2024) ; Deng et al. (2025) , a fixed set of retrieved pages Chia et al. (2025) ; Han et al. (2025) , or an agentic tool loop Lee et al. (2024) ; Jain et al. (2025) , rather than comparing these choices head to head. This leaves the cost/accuracy trade-off across VLM scale largely open.
blocks.zh: 前沿多式联运模式,API侧Anthropic(2025); Hurst等人(2024年);Team等人(2024年)和露天重量级的Quen队(2026年); Chen et al.(2024b);Liu et al.(2024);Wu et al.(2024),直接接受页面图像,并越来越多地在长文档QA上做得很好,没有文档特定的架构. 长文本模型的研究主要在文本侧面Liu等人(2025年),而对于多式联运文件的评价通常承诺采用单一访问模式,无论是所有页面图像Ma等人(2024年);Deng等人(2025年),一套固定的检索页面Chia等人(2025年);Han等人(2025年),还是代理工具环路Lee等人(2024年);Jain等人(2025年),而不是将这些选择头类比做头类. 这就使得在自愿工序上的成本/准确性之间的权衡基本上可以进行。

blocks.en: 2.3 Page Retrieval over Long Documents
blocks.zh: 2.3 对长文件的检索

blocks.en: Lexical BM25 Robertson and Zaragoza (2009) over OCR or layout-aware text remains a strong and low-cost baseline for page retrieval. Dense bi-encoders Karpukhin et al. (2020) ; Chen et al. (2024a) and late-interaction models Khattab and Zaharia (2020) match or exceed BM25 at higher compute cost, and ColPali Faysse et al. (2025) extends this idea to vision by representing each page as an image. A second-stage rerank trades latency for accuracy, with cross-encoder Nogueira and Cho (2019) and LLM-based Sun et al. (2023) variants commonly used. For long-document QA specifically, recent work either changes what gets indexed Jiang et al. (2024) or layers LLM-driven steps such as document enrichment, query rewriting, and reranking on top of BM25 Yang et al. (2026) ; Gao et al. (2023) ; Asai et al. (2024) . The contribution of each step relative to the underlying text source is rarely isolated, which is what we examine in our retrieval ablation.
blocks.zh: Lexical BM25 Robertson和Zaragoza(2009年)在OCR或布局意识文本上,仍然是页面检索的有力和低成本基准. Dense双编码器Karpukhin等人(2020年);Chen等人(2024年a)和后期互动模型Khattab和Zaharia(2020年)以较高的计算成本匹配或超过BM25,ColPali Faysse等人. (2023)常用变种. 具体地说,对于长文件QA, 近期的工作要么改变被索引的Jiang等人(2024年),要么改变文件浓缩、查询重写等LLM驱动的层次步骤,并重新排在BM25 Yang等人(2026年);Gao等人(2023年);Asai等人(2024年)。 每个步骤相对于基础文本来源的贡献很少被孤立,这是我们在检索衰减中审查的内容.

blocks.en: 2.4 Agentic and Tool-Using Document QA
blocks.zh: 2.4 代理和工具使用文档QA

blocks.en: Tool-augmented agents Yao et al. (2022) ; Shinn et al. (2023) interleave tool calls with reasoning. For long documents, an agent explores the document on demand instead of reading a fixed input, trading one inference call for several tool-call rounds. Earlier text-only designs use gist memory or recursive document structure Lee et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024) , and retrieval-augmented variants add search-and-fetch tools Qwen Team (2024) .
blocks.zh: 工具化代理姚等人(2022年) ; Shinn等人(2023年) 互换工具调用推理. 对于较长的文档,一个代理商按需对文档进行探索,而不是读取固定输入,用一个推论来交换几个工具调用回合. 早期仅文本设计使用gist内存或递归文档结构 Lee et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2024) , 和 retrieved-augmented variats 添加搜索和查找工具 Quen Team (2024) .

blocks.en: Recent multimodal agents extend these designs to visual evidence. MDocAgent Han et al. (2025) routes queries through five specialised agents on top of a multimodal RAG retriever, DocLens Zhu et al. (2025) splits the task across navigation, localization, and reasoning roles, and SimpleDoc Jain et al. (2025) , the closest analogue to our setup, runs an LLM reasoner that iteratively pulls retrieved pages into a working memory for a separate VLM answerer. Other concurrent designs train scrolling policies Lim et al. (2026) , decompose the task into planning, execution, judgement, and answer agents Yu et al. (2026) , or extend multimodal RAG to multi-document QA Suri et al. (2025) . These systems span a wide compute range, from a single VLM with a small toolkit to multi-model stacks that pair a separate retrieval model with a 32B vision-language answerer, and most depend on per-document preprocessing such as per-page summaries or vision embeddings. They have largely been compared to other agentic systems rather than to a strong static retrieval-and-read pipeline.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We study long-document multimodal question answering as a deployment problem. A system S S is a function S ⁡ ( D , q ) → a S(D,q)\to a that maps a document D D (a long PDF with heterogeneous content) to a textual answer a a for a natural-language question q q . The question may require evidence from a single page, non-adjacent pages, or none of the document at all. We decompose S S into three design choices that a practitioner can change one at a time. • Input modality I I : what form of D D reaches the VLM that answers the question, which we call the reader (raw PDF, page images, extracted text, or a retrieved subset). • Retriever R R : how pages are ranked by relevance to q q when I I keeps only the top k k . • Agentic policy π \pi : trivial (single forward pass of static input) or a multi-turn tool-call loop in which the VLM decides what to look at next.

blocks.en: We evaluate five input modalities (raw PDF, all-pages images, plain-text, layout-aware text, and top- k k retrieved images), retrievers spanning lexical, dense-text, vision late-interaction, and rerank families, and several agent designs covering function-calling, gist-based, and iterative-refinement styles. Our readers are Claude Sonnet 4.5, served through a hosted API, and the open-weight Qwen3.5-{4B, 9B, 27B}, served locally. Appendices B – J give the full retriever and VLM configurations.

blocks.en: All systems are scored on MMLongBench-Doc Ma et al. (2024) and LongDocURL Deng et al. (2025) . Following each benchmark’s own evaluation protocol, an answer extractor LLM (Claude Haiku 4.5) normalises each free-form response into a short answer before comparison against the gold answer by the benchmark’s official deterministic scorer; we use MMLongBench-Doc’s released extraction prompt unchanged and apply it identically to every system we run, including the external baselines ReadAgent and SimpleDoc. It is distinct from the text extractors (PyMuPDF, MinerU) used by the text-input modes. The step is not cosmetic: without it, correct answers inside explanatory prose score zero under the whole-string official scorers (Appendix M ). We report per-question accuracy and mean input tokens, where the token count covers access-mode and agent-loop cost but excludes one-time preprocessing and retrieval-time compute, which Appendix H reports separately.
blocks.zh: 所有系统均在MMLong Bench-Doc Ma等人(2024年)和LongDocURL Deng等人(2025年)上得分. 根据每个基准本身的评价协议,一个解答提取器LLM(Claude Haiku 4.5)将每个自由格式的响应常态化为一个简短的答案,然后用基准的官方确定分数比对黄金答案;我们使用MMLong Bench-Doc的释放提取提示,没有改变,并同样应用到我们运行的每个系统,包括外部基线ReadAgent和SimpleDoc. 它与文本输入模式所使用的文本提取器(PyMuPDF, MinerU)不同. 该步骤不是化妆品:没有它,解释性道具内部的正确答案在全弦官方计分器(Appendix M )下得分为0. 我们报告每个问题精确度和输入值,其中表示值数包括访问模式和代理启动成本,但不包括一次性预处理和检索时间计算,附录H分别报告。

blocks.en: 3.1 Six-Tool Function-Calling Agent
blocks.zh: 3.1 六工具函数调用代理

blocks.en: Our agentic baseline is a function-calling loop in which a VLM explores the document on demand.
blocks.zh: 我们的代理基准是一个函数调用循环,一个VLM在其中按需探索文档.

blocks.en: We run MinerU Niu et al. (2025) on each PDF to extract its layout structure (section headings, figure/table crops, and per-page text blocks) and build a structural catalog . The catalog lists, for each page, its section title, page range, and the figures/tables it contains, each with a stable integer id. This catalog is provided to the VLM as a compact preamble alongside the question.
blocks.zh: 我们管理MinerU Niu等人(2025年)在每个PDF上提取其布局结构(节标题,图/表作物,以及每页文字块)并构建一个结构目录. 该目录列出了每一页,其章节标题,页面范围,及其包含的数字/表格,每页都有稳定的整数ID. 这份目录作为紧凑的序言与问题一并提供给《自愿地雷议定书》。

blocks.en: The model chooses one or more tools at each turn from: • get_catalog : returns the full structural catalog (used when the preamble is truncated for very large documents). • read_pages(pages) : renders the requested pages as images at a model-chosen size, 700 700 or 1,400 1{,}400 px on the longest side. • get_figure(id) : returns the MinerU-extracted figure crop by stable id. • get_table(id) : returns the table crop and its structured HTML. • search_text(query, top_k) : runs BM25 over MinerU per-page text blocks and returns the top-scoring page numbers, each with a matching text excerpt. • finish(answer) : commits the final answer and ends the loop.
blocks.zh: 模型在每个转弯时选择一个或多个工具从: • get_catalog : 返回完整的结构目录(在对非常大的文档切除序言时使用). • 读取页码(页码):使要求的页码成为模型选择大小的图像,700 700 或1 400 1{,}400 px在最长的一侧。 • 获得_图(id):用稳定的ID返回MinerU提取的图庄。 • 获得表(id): 返回表条及其结构化的 HTML。 • 搜索_文本(清空,顶端_k):在Miner上运行 BM25 U 每页文本块并返回最高评分的页码,每个页码都有匹配的文本节选. • 结束(回答): 输入最后答案并结束循环。

blocks.zh: 获取_图(id) : 以稳定 id 返回 MinerU 提取的图裁剪。

blocks.zh: get_table(id) : 返回表格裁剪及其结构化的 HTML。

blocks.en: The loop is capped at eight tool calls per question; in practice the median is two (Appendix L ). If a tool call references an invalid id, the agent receives an error message and may retry on the next turn.

blocks.en: Unlike gist-based agents Lee et al. (2024) , ours sees actual page images, preserving visual evidence. Unlike multi-agent pipelines that fix retrieval mode up front Han et al. (2025) ; Jain et al. (2025) , a single model can mix strategies within one question: for example, search_text to locate a section, then get_table to read a specific table. Dedicated element tools provide higher resolution than full-page rendering.

blocks.en: 4.1 Input Modality
blocks.zh: 4.1 输入方式

blocks.en: We first compare the static whole-document modalities: raw PDF, all-images, and extracted text. Raw PDF is the strongest of these for Sonnet on MMLongBench (0.522) but also by far the most expensive, at 80k input tokens per question. The cost comes from how the API ingests a PDF, sending both a rendered image and an extracted text layer for every page. All-images is weaker than raw PDF in part because it sends the rendered pages without that text layer. It is also constrained by the API’s 100-image-per-request limit: documents of more than 100 pages are packed into merged images at lower per-page resolution (Appendix B ). On MMLongBench, the Qwen3.5 family, served locally without this limit, beats Sonnet on the same mode by 5 5 – 11 11 pp, and by as much on documents of at most 50 pages, where Sonnet pays no penalty, so the gap is the reader, not the cap.
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较静态的全文件模式:原始的PDF,全图像,以及提取的文本. 在MMLong Bench(0.522)上,Raw PDF是Sonnet最强的,但迄今为止也是最昂贵的,每题80k输入符. 成本来自API如何摄入一个PDF,为每页发送一个渲染的图像和一个提取的文本层. 所有图像都比原始的PDF弱,部分原因是它发送的已渲染的页面没有文本层. 也受API的百度图像/要求限制:超过100页的文件以较低的每页分辨率(Appendix B)包装成合并的图像. 在MMLong Bench上,Qwen3.5家族在当地服役,没有这个限制,在相同模式下以5 5–11 11 pp击败了索内特,在最多50页的文档上也以同样多的优势击败了索内特,索内特不给罚,所以差距是读者,而不是上限.

blocks.en: Text-only modes are the weakest input for the open-weight readers on MMLongBench, trailing all-images by 13 13 – 17 17 pp at 4B and 9B because they drop in-document images; for Sonnet they are competitive instead, since its all-images accuracy drops sharply on documents beyond about 50 pages. The strongest text-only configuration still trails top- k k image retrieval by about 5 5 pp at a matched reader, so reading the page beats reading its extracted text. Table questions are the one exception, where a layout-aware extractor recovers structured cell content and matches or beats images on MMLongBench. On MMLongBench, MinerU lifts Sonnet’s text-only accuracy by about 8 8 pp over plain-text extraction with PyMuPDF, and the gain concentrates on table and figure questions. The benefit is benchmark-dependent, since on LongDocURL plain-text and layout-aware extraction tie at Sonnet. Appendix C has the full sweep.
blocks.zh: 仅文本模式是MMLong Bench上开放量阅读器最弱的输入方式,在4B和9B上以13 13 — 17 17页的速度排在了所有图像之后;对于Sonnet来说,它们是竞争性的,因为其所有图像的准确性在超过50页的文档上急剧下降。 最强的文本唯一配置仍然在匹配的阅读器上以大约5 5 pp跟踪到顶端的-k k 图像检索,因此读取页面会比读取其提取的文本要快. 表格问题是一个例外,一个布局感知提取器可以回收结构化的单元格内容,匹配或比照MMLong Bench上的图像. 在MMLONG BENCH,矿工 U在与PyMuPDF的纯文本提取上, 好处取决于基准,因为在Sonnet的LongDocURL纯文本和布局意识提取带上。 附 录 C有全扫荡。

blocks.en: With text input, scale buys the Qwen3.5 family little below 27B. On MMLongBench the 4B and 9B models land within a point of each other, 8 to 9 pp below Sonnet on the same MinerU input; the 27B run fails on 111 long-document requests and scores zero there, and on the questions it completes it is about 11 11 pp above 9B. On LongDocURL the Qwen text runs fail outright on 895 of the 2,325 questions and score zero there, at a rate that climbs with document length from 18 % 18\% of the shortest bin to 72 % 72\% of the longest; on the questions they complete, the three sizes land within 2 pp of each other and of Sonnet.
blocks.zh: 有了文字输入,规模购买了小于27B的Quen3.5家族. 在MMLong Bench上,4B和9B模型在彼此的某一点内着陆,在Sonnet下8至9页在同一MinerU输入上;在111个长文件请求上,27B运行失败,并在那里得分为零,在它完成的问题上大约是9B以上11页. 在LongDocURL上, Quen的文本在2,325个问题中的895个问题上完全失败, 得分为零, 其速度以文件长度从最短的垃圾桶的18%(18)上升到最长的72%(72),

blocks.en: Access mode also governs how gracefully accuracy scales with document length. Figure 1 bins LongDocURL by page count: raw-PDF accuracy collapses by 42.6 42.6 pp from the 50–75 to the 125–150 page bin, mostly because the request itself fails above the API’s per-request cap and scores zero, whereas retrieval, the agent, and all-images at a local reader that sees every page individually vary by at most 5 5 pp across the full range. The agent rows are the flattest, and the Sonnet agent is highest in every bin. The collapse is not an artifact of the single request: splitting documents into chunks under the cap and combining per-chunk answers recovers nothing (Appendix P ). Per-bin tables for both benchmarks are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 访问模式也制约着文档长度的优雅精确度。 图1 bins LongDocURL按页数排列: 原始-PDF精度从50–75页到125–150页的bin下降了42.6 42.6页,这主要是因为请求本身没有超过API的每页要求上限,得分为零,而检索,代理和全景则在全程每个页面的本地读者中分别看到最多5-5页. 代理行是最扁平的,索内特务在每一个宾馆都最高. 崩溃不是单项请求的一件文物:将文档分割成封顶下的块,合并每堆答案不会恢复任何东西(附录P. 两个基准的每期表格载于附录E。

blocks.en: Enabling a reasoning (“thinking”) budget before the model answers gives modest gains, up to about 6 6 pp and largest where the input is largest, and never changes the modality ordering; we report no-think numbers throughout for a matched-decoding comparison and defer the full sweep to Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 在模型答案之前允许一个推理(“思考”)预算,可以产生微小的收益,在输入量最大的地区最多可达6,6页,而且最大,而且决不改变模式顺序;我们报告整个没有思维的数字,以便进行匹配的解码比较,并将全部扫描推迟到附录G。

blocks.en: Figure 2 makes the accuracy/cost trade-off explicit, plotting each access mode’s best configuration by accuracy against mean input tokens per question. Top- k k image retrieval sits in the efficient corner (0.51–0.56 at 7.6–9 k tokens), the 6-tool agent is the most accurate (0.616–0.625 at 20–33 k tokens), and raw PDF is the outlier, spending 80 k tokens for 0.522. Only top- k k retrieval and the agent lie on the Pareto frontier: raw PDF and extracted text are dominated by both, and all-images (0.588 at 30 k) is dominated by the Sonnet agent, which is both more accurate and cheaper (0.625 at 20 k); top- k k is cheaper still but 6 6 pp less accurate than the agent.

blocks.en: 4.2 Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.2 检索

blocks.en: A retrieval pipeline ranks the document’s pages and sends only the top k k to the VLM. We use k = 5 k=5 throughout unless stated otherwise, the depth of every Top-5 row in Table 1 ; a depth sweep (Appendix I ) shows accuracy peaks near k = 10 k{=}10 and that k = 5 k{=}5 captures most of it at roughly half the tokens. We measure retrieval with Hit@5, the fraction of answerable questions whose top-5 pages include an evidence page. We evaluate retrievers from four families: BM25 Robertson and Zaragoza (2009) (lexical word overlap), BGE-M3 Chen et al. (2024a) (dense-text bi-encoder), ColQwen2.5 Faysse et al. (2025) and Nemotron-ColEmbed-3B (Nem-CE) Moreira et al. (2026) (late-interaction over page images), and rerank pipelines that stack a cross-encoder or full LLM rerank on a base retriever, including SIRA Yang et al. (2026) . We also build a cascade: Nem-CE-3B first prefilters each document to 50 candidate pages, and Scout, a Qwen3.5-9B model prompted to read those candidates and rank them, selects the final top 5.
blocks.zh: 一个检索管道对文档的页面进行排序,并且只向 VLM 发送顶端 kk 。 除非另有说明,否则我们在整个过程中使用k = 5 k = 5;表1中每个Top-5行的深度;深度扫描(附录一)显示精度峰值接近k = 10 k{=}10,k = 5 k{=}5以大约一半的符号捕捉大部分. 我们用Hit@5来测量检索,回答问题的一小部分,其顶端5页包括一个证据页。 我们评价了四个家庭的检索器:BM25 Robertson和Zaragoza(2009年)(语词重叠)、BGE-M3 Chen等人(2024年a)(双编码器),Col Quen2.5 Faysse等人(2025年)和Nemotron-ColEmbed-3B (Nem-CE) Moreira等人(2026年)(在页面图像上进行晚交),以及将跨编码器或全LLM重排在基检索器上的管道重新排序,包括SIRA Yang等人(2026年)。 我们还建造一个级联: Nem-CE-3B首先将每个文档预过滤到50个候选页,而Scout,一个Quen3.5-9B模型促使阅读这些候选页并排位,选择最后的前5名.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , modality is the dominant axis in retrieval. Averaged across both benchmarks, the image retrievers ColQwen2.5 and Nem-CE reach 87.2 and 91.4 Hit@5, while no text retriever exceeds 82.4, so the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline by about 9 pp and the strongest base image retriever (Nem-CE) leads the strongest base text retriever (BGE-M3) by roughly 17 pp. The effect carries downstream to answer accuracy, not just retrieval: with the same reader, five retrieved page images match the whole document’s extracted text on MMLongBench (0.508 vs. 0.480, a paired gap whose interval includes zero) while sending under a third of the input tokens (7.6k vs. 27k), and the per-evidence breakdown favours images on every source except Tables, where MinerU’s structured cell HTML wins on MMLongBench though not on LongDocURL (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,模式是检索的主要轴。 平均跨越两个基准,图像检索器ColQwen2.5和Nem-CE达到87.2和91.4 Hit@5,而文本检索器不超过82.4,因此最强图像检索器领导最强文本管道约9pp,最强基图像检索器(Nem-CE)领导最强基文本检索器(BGE-M3)约17pp. 该效果带入下游以回答准确性,而不只是检索:用同一阅读器,五张检索的页面图像匹配了整个文档在MMLong Bench上提取的文本(0.508对0.480,一个对位空白,其间隔包括0),同时发送的输入令牌不到三分之一(7.6k对27k),每张证据分解都有利于每个来源的图像,除了表格,MinerU结构化的单元格HTML在MMLong Bench上获胜,尽管不在LongDocURL上(表3).

blocks.en: On the text side, the reranker matters more than the base retriever. Dense BGE-M3 leads lexical BM25 by only 4.3 4.3 pp on average (74.1 vs. 69.8), but adding Cohere Rerank 3.5 Cohere (2024) lifts both by 8 to 12 pp and renders them indistinguishable afterward (82.0 vs. 82.1). A single such rerank is statistically indistinguishable from SIRA’s full multi-stage pipeline (82.4 vs. 82.0; on MMLongBench the paired Hit@5 difference is + 0.1 +0.1 pp, 95 % 95\% CI [ − 2.8 , + 2.9 ] [-2.8,+2.9] , Appendix M ), with no LLM in the loop (Appendix H ).

blocks.en: Reranking does not carry over to the already-strong image retrievers. Stacking the Scout reranker on Nem-CE gives the best MMLongBench Hit@5 in the table ( + 2.4 +2.4 pp) but loses 11.3 11.3 pp on LongDocURL, a net drop of 4.5 4.5 pp on average against plain Nem-CE. The loss is a document-length effect: binning LongDocURL by page count, Scout’s Hit@5 deficit against plain Nem-CE widens from − 5.7 -5.7 pp on 50–75-page documents to − 22.0 -22.0 pp on 125+-page documents, while Nem-CE alone stays flat ( 0.92 0.92 – 0.95 0.95 across all bins). On long documents Scout increasingly demotes the evidence page that Nem-CE alone had ranked in its top five; MMLongBench’s shorter documents rarely trigger this, which is why the cascade helps there. The full per-bin breakdown is in Appendix F .

blocks.en: 4.3 Agentic Access
blocks.zh: 4.3 代理访问

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the 6-tool function-calling (FC) agent is the highest-scoring single-VLM configuration we measured at frontier scale on both benchmarks; it beats the best retrieve-then-generate pipeline on MMLongBench and is level with it on LongDocURL.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,6工具函数调用(FC)代理是我们在两个基准的前沿尺度上测得的最高得分的单VLM配置;它比MMLong Bench上最佳的回收-转基因管道要好,在LongDocURL上与之同级.

blocks.en: This advantage appears only above a scale threshold. On MMLongBench the FC agent trails both static image modes at Qwen3.5-4B (0.471 vs. 0.526 all-images and 0.551 top-5) and at 9B (0.497 vs. 0.559 and 0.564), draws level with the best of them at 27B (0.616 vs. 0.588, a + 2.8 +2.8 pp paired gap whose interval includes zero), and leads at Sonnet 4.5 (0.625 vs. 0.533). The transition sits between 9B and 27B: below it, a reader is better served by simply being shown every page. Among static modes at open-weight scale, top- k k retrieval and all-images are indistinguishable in accuracy, with the paired interval including zero at both 4B and 9B, while top- k k uses under a third of the input tokens (9k vs. 33k at 9B), so top- k k is the better static default rather than merely the cheaper one. LongDocURL shows no such threshold: the agent leads top- k k retrieval at its own reader already at 4B and 9B, and at 27B and Sonnet 4.5 it is level with the best static pipeline; the largest step is again 9B to 27B. The smallest agent is also the most expensive, and not because it searches more: every Qwen reader reaches its answer within two to three tool calls, and what separates them is whether they stop. Qwen3.5-4B re-emits finish after its answer is recorded on 51 % 51\% of MMLongBench trajectories and 75 % 75\% on LongDocURL, adding 9.1 9.1 and 4.9 4.9 further model calls that re-send the accumulated context, against 1.5 1.5 and 0.3 0.3 for 27B. Knowing when to stop is a capability: toolkit and loop are identical across the Qwen readers, so 4B’s 77 77 k against 33 33 k is the price of a reader that does not end its loop (Appendix J ).
blocks.zh: 这一优势似乎仅高于一个比额表阈值。 在MMLong Bench上,FC代理跟踪在Quen3.5-4B(0.471对0.526全图像和0.551顶5)和9B(0.497对0.559和0.564)的静态图像模式下,以27B(0.616对0.588,一个+2.8+2.8页的对数差距,其间距包括0)和Sonnet4.5(0.625对0.533)为最优画平面。 过渡时间介于9B至27B之间:在下面,只显示每一页就能更好地为读者服务. 在开放量级的静态模式中,顶-k检索和全图像精度无法区分,对偶间隔包括0,同时在4B和9B,而顶-k在输入符的三分之一下使用(9k vs 33k at 9B),所以顶-k是更好的静态默认,而不仅仅是更便宜的默认. 龙度 显示没有这样的阈值: 代理在它自己的读取器上在 4B 和 9B 上领先 —— k reference, 在 27B 和 Sonnet 4. 5 上是 最好的静态管道 ; 最大的步骤是 9B 到 27B 。 最小的代理也是最昂贵的 而不是因为它搜索更多: 每 Quen阅读器在2到3个工具调用中到达了它的答案,它们之间的区别在于它们是否停止. Qwen3.5-4B在回答后重新填充,记录在MMLONG Bench轨迹的51%-51%和LongDocURL的75%75%上,增加了9.1.9.1和4.9.4.9进一步调用重播累积上下文,而27B为1.51.5和0.30.3。 了解何时停止是一种能力:工具箱和环路在Quen阅读器之间是相同的,所以4B的7777k对3333k是一个不结束其环路的阅读器的价格(附录J).

blocks.en: ReadAgent Lee et al. (2024) , which uses a gist-based design, lands well below our toolkit on MMLongBench and only modestly below on LongDocURL. It looks up a median of two pages per question and reads them through a compressed gist memory, so it often misses the evidence page and loses the fine-grained list and table detail that our structured catalog preserves. The gains therefore come from the toolkit, not from acting agentically alone.
blocks.zh: 读取代理 Lee et al. (2024年),它使用一种基于地心的设计,在MMLONG Bench上远远低于我们的工具包,在LongDocURL上仅略低于我们的工具包。 它检查每个问题2页的中位数,通过压缩的吉斯记忆来读取它们,所以它经常错过证据页,并丢失了我们结构化目录所保存的精细的目录和表格细节. 因此,收益来自工具包,而不是仅靠代理行为。

blocks.en: We evaluate three multi-agent systems on the same two benchmarks. MDocAgent Han et al. (2025) routes a question through five agents and answers with Qwen2-VL-7B over ColPali top- k = 4 k=4 pages. SimpleDoc Jain et al. (2025) runs a Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoner that repeatedly pulls dual-cue retrieved pages into a working memory before a Qwen2.5-VL-32B answerer responds. DocLens Zhu et al. (2025) splits the task across a Page Navigator, an Element Localizer, and a Reasoner.

blocks.en: MDocAgent and SimpleDoc score under binary LLM judges (GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 respectively) rather than each benchmark’s official deterministic scorer, so the published figures sit above what the official scorer would assign. To place SimpleDoc on the same footing, we re-ran its full pipeline with Sonnet 4.5 in every role under the deterministic scorer. This reproduces its MMLongBench result (0.608 vs. 0.606) and yields 0.634 on LongDocURL, about 8.9 8.9 pp below the judge-scored 0.723.

blocks.en: The 6-tool FC agent is competitive with all of these systems, but only the SimpleDoc comparison is strictly like-for-like. At a matched VLM under the same deterministic scorer our agent is 1.6 1.6 pp ahead on MMLongBench, [ − 1.1 , + 4.4 ] [-1.1,+4.4] , which we report as a tie. The DocLens rows use its own protocol, so those comparisons are indicative; our closest row is the Sonnet agent, level with DocLens’s Claude-4-Sonnet configuration and below its Gemini-2.5-Pro one. MDocAgent reaches only 0.315, far enough back that the judge leniency cannot account for the gap. On LongDocURL the same agent leads SimpleDoc-Sonnet by 2.5 2.5 pp and MDocAgent by about 8 8 pp.
blocks.zh: 6工具的FC代理与所有这些系统都有竞争,但只有SimpleDoc的比较严格来说是相似的. 我们的经纪人在MMLong Bench上领先1.6页,[− 1.1,+ 4.4] [-1.1,+4.4]。 DocLens行使用它自己的协议,所以这些比较是指示性的;我们最近的一行是Sonnet代理,与DocLens的Claude-4-Sonnet配置同级,并低于它的双子座2.5-Pro one。 MDocAgent只达到0.315,远远回溯到法官宽大处理无法解释差距. 在LongDocURL上,同一代理领先SimpleDoc-Sonnet2.5 pp,MdocAgent约8 8 pp.

blocks.en: A single strong VLM with a structural catalog and direct figure and table access recovers visual evidence more reliably than a pipeline of smaller specialized models, and at lower cost: our agent runs one VLM over a lightweight MinerU-derived catalog in a median of two tool calls, with no second large model in the loop and no per-page offline indexing. Appendix K sets all five agentic systems side by side on this cost axis.
blocks.zh: 一个具有结构目录和直接图和表访问的单一强VLM比一个较小的专用模型的管道更可靠地恢复视觉证据,成本更低:我们的代理人在一个轻量级的MinerU衍生目录上运行一个VLM,中间值为两个工具调用,循环中没有第二个大模型,没有每页的离线索引. 附录K在此成本轴上将所有五个代理系统并列.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We studied three deployment-level choices for long-document multimodal QA (input modality, retrieval, and agentic access) across two benchmarks under one extractor and evaluator. The findings reduce to a decision tree. With a frontier API , a six-tool function-calling agent is the highest-accuracy configuration we measured, at roughly 1.5 1.5 – 7 × 7\times fewer input tokens per question than sending all pages as images or the raw PDF. With a smaller open-weight VLM (Qwen3.5-9B and below), tool use is a poor trade: on MMLongBench the agent trails plain all-images input, on LongDocURL its lead over top-5 retrieval is a few points, and in both cases it spends 4 4 – 9 × 9\times the tokens of top-5 retrieval. Static image input is the better default at this scale; top-5 retrieval matches all-images on accuracy at a fraction of the tokens. When images cannot be sent , a layout-aware extractor (MinerU) with BM25 or BGE-M3 and a single cross-encoder rerank matches a multi-stage design’s text-side accuracy at a fraction of its compute. Beyond any single pipeline , three of our strongest configurations make different mistakes and leave roughly 13 13 pp of per-question oracle headroom (Table 1 ), but that headroom resists the obvious remedy: routing on gold evidence type recovers under a point of it, and a router on observable question features is worse than always running the agent ( − 0.9 -0.9 pp on MMLongBench, − 7.1 -7.1 pp on LongDocURL; Appendix O ), because the complementarity lies within evidence types rather than across them, and recovering it needs a finer per-question signal than any we tested. A small, well-chosen toolkit can stand in for a larger multi-agent stack.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个提取器和评价器下研究了在两个基准上对长文件式多式联运质量保证(输入方式、检索和代理准入)的三个部署级别选择。 调查结果沦为决策树。 使用边疆 API, 六工具函数调用代理器是我们测得的最高精确度配置, 大约1.5 — — 7 — 7次每题输入符号比发送所有页面作为图像或原始PDF少。 使用一个较小的开放重量的VLM(Quen3.5-9B和以下),工具使用是一个差的交易:在MMLong Bench上,代理跟踪纯全图像输入,在LongDocURL上,其顶级5检索的领先点是几分,在这两种情况下,它花费4 4 — 9 × 9\\时间是顶级5检索的标志. 静态图像输入是这个比例尺上更好的默认;顶5检索在精确度上与所有图像匹配到一小部分的符号. 当图像无法发送时,带有BM25或BGE-M3的布局感知提取器(MinerU)和一个单跨编码器重新排序与多阶段设计在计算中的文本侧精度相匹配. 除了任何单一的管道外,我们的三个最强的配置会犯不同的错误,并留下大约13页的每个问题oracle头室(表1),但头室抵制明显的补救方法:黄金证据类型的路由在某一点下恢复,可观察到的问题特性的路由器比通常运行的代理人更差(MMLong Bench上的0.9-0.9页,LongDocURL上的7.1-7.1页;附录O),因为互补性在于证据类型,而不是相互之间,恢复它需要比我们测试过的更精细的每个问题信号。 一个小的,精选的工具包可以代表一个更大的多剂堆.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: A few aspects of our setup limit the scope of our findings. We study long-document question answering only, the task both benchmarks target, and do not measure summarization, extraction, or classification; while the three axes we vary (input modality, retrieval, and agentic access) are task-general choices, whether the specific rankings transfer to other long-document tasks is left to future work, and we do not claim generality beyond QA. The two benchmarks together contain 3,407 questions over 531 long documents, and differences below about 3 3 pp on MMLongBench-Doc and 2 2 pp on LongDocURL are within noise (Appendix M ), so we avoid fine-grained ordering claims at that scale. The unified scorer combines an answer-extractor LLM with a benchmark-native string-and-numeric matcher, and when a system already returns a short structured answer (such as the function-calling agent’s finish argument), the extractor adds little, which may slightly understate that system’s lead. On the API side, Sonnet caps the number of images per request and limits each image to 8000 pixels on a side, and our pipeline silently falls back by stitching and resizing page images for very long documents; beyond a further size threshold the request fails outright and is scored zero (Appendix B ). Numbers we report from commercial VLM endpoints reflect that fallback, and on-premise serving may behave differently. Finally, our results assume English-language documents and the VLM families we tested, and whether the rankings carry over to other languages and to smaller on-device VLMs is open. Errors concentrate on charts and figures on MMLongBench-Doc and on layout-bearing pages on LongDocURL (Table 3 ), so a benchmark with a different evidence mix would likely reorder the leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 我们设置的几个方面限制了我们调查结果的范围。 我们只研究长文件问题回答,任务两个基准目标,不衡量归纳,提取,或分类;虽然我们各不相同的三轴(输入模式,检索,和代理访问)是任务一般的选择,具体向其他长文件任务转移的排名是否留给未来工作,我们并不声称超出QA的概括性. 这两个基准共包含3,407个问题,超过531个长文件,在MMLong Bench-Doc和LongDocURL上的大约3,3页以下的差异在噪声中(附录M),因此我们避免了如此规模的细微命令索赔. 统一的计分器将一个解答-提取器LLM和基准-内置字符串-数字匹配器合并在一起,当一个系统已经返回一个结构短的答案(如函数调用代理的结束参数)时,提取器会增加很少,这可能略微低估了系统的领先性. 在API方面,Sonnet将每个请求的图像数量封顶,将每个图像限制在一边的8000像素,我们的管道静悄悄地通过对非常长的文档进行缝合和调整大小的页面图像回落;在更大的尺寸阈值之外,请求完全失败,得分为零(附录B ). 我们从商业 VLM 端点报告的数字 反映了倒计时, 和在前提服务 可能行为不同。 最后,我们的结果假设了英语文件和我们测试过的VLM家族,以及排名是否延续到其他语言和较小的on-device VLMs是开放的. 错误集中于关于MMLong Bench-Doc的图表和数字,以及LongDocURL(表3)的带有布局的页面,因此一个具有不同证据组合的基准可能会重排领导板的顺序.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work uses two public document QA benchmarks (MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL), neither of which contains personally identifying information or sensitive personal data. All VLMs and retrievers are publicly released models or commercial APIs accessed under their standard terms of service. We do not collect any new human-labeled data and run no experiments with human subjects. The systems we evaluate produce textual answers grounded in the input document, which limits the risk of fabrication, but a deployed system should still surface its source pages to the user so that incorrect answers are auditable. Our cost numbers are reported in input tokens per question rather than in dollars to avoid pinning recommendations to any single provider’s pricing, which can change.
blocks.zh: 这部作品采用了两个公开文件QA基准(MMLong Bench-Doc和LongDocURL),其中都没有包含个人识别信息或敏感的个人数据. 所有VLM和检索器都是公开发布的模型或商业API根据其标准服务条款访问. 我们不收集任何新的人类标注数据,也不进行人类实验。 我们评价的系统产生基于输入文件的文字答案,这限制了制造的风险,但部署的系统仍应当向用户显示其源页,以便不正确的答案可以审计。 我们的费用数字以每个问题输入符号而不是以美元报告,以避免将建议投向任何单一提供者的定价,而这种定价可能会改变。

blocks.en: Appendix B How the Claude API Processes Raw PDFs
blocks.zh: 附录B Claude API 处理原始 PDF 的方式

blocks.en: The raw-PDF row in Table 1 hands the unmodified PDF to the Claude API rather than rendering page images ourselves, so its behaviour is set by the API’s own document pipeline. We access Claude through its hosted API, and we document its handling here because it explains both the high token cost of raw-PDF input and its collapse on long documents (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 表1中的原始-PDF行将未修改的PDF交给克劳德API,而不是自己渲染页面图像,因此其行为由API自己的文件管道设定. 我们通过它的主机API访问克劳德,我们在这里记录它的处理,因为它解释了原始-PDF输入的高昂象征性成本及其在长文件上的崩溃(附录E ).

blocks.en: With citations enabled, the Claude API converts each PDF page into an image and provides the text extracted from that page alongside it, so the model sees both a rendered view and an OCR-style text layer for every page, at roughly 7 7 k tokens for a three-page PDF. Without citations it falls back to basic text extraction at roughly 1 1 k tokens for the same pages and cannot analyse charts, figures, or visual layout. We enable citations in every raw-PDF run so that Claude sees the visual content, which is why the raw-PDF token counts in Table 1 are the highest of any access mode.
blocks.zh: 启用引用后,Claude API将每个PDF页面转换成一个图像,并同时提供从该页面中提取的文本,因此模型看到每个页面的渲染视图和一个OCR风格的文本层,一个三页PDF的大约7,7千个令牌. 在不引用的情况下,它回到基本文本提取,大约为同一页的11千个符号,无法分析图表、数字或视觉布局。 我们允许在每一个原始的 PDF 运行中引用,以便克劳德看到视觉内容,这就是为什么表1中的原始 PDF 符号计数是任何访问模式中最高的.

blocks.en: Under full visual mode each page costs roughly 1.5 1.5 k to 3 3 k text tokens depending on content density, plus the image tokens for the rendered page. A single request is capped at 32 32 MB and at 100 100 pages for the 200 200 k-token-context models we use. When a document exceeds these limits the API downsamples the embedded page images to fit, which reduces per-page resolution on long documents; beyond a further threshold the request fails outright and we score it zero, which accounts for most of the raw-PDF accuracy collapse reported in Appendix E . blocks.en: LongDocURL spans 51–149 pages per document, while MMLongBench-Doc spans 9–468 pages with a mean of 48, so LongDocURL lets us isolate how each access mode degrades as page count grows over a tighter, longer-skewed range. We bin LongDocURL questions by their document’s total page count and compute Sonnet accuracy per bin under the official LongDocURL scorer (Table 7 ). Two patterns are clear.
blocks.zh: LongDocURL 的长度为每份文件51–149页,而 MMLong Bench-Doc 的长度为9–468页,平均为48页,所以LongDocURL让我们隔离每个访问模式如何随着页面在更紧的,更长的剪切范围内增长而退化。 在官方的LongDocURL计分器下, 两种模式是明确的。

blocks.en: First, raw-PDF access collapses on long documents, from 0.574 0.574 on 50–75-page documents to 0.148 0.148 on 125–150-page documents, a − 42.6 -42.6 pp drop. Most of that drop is outright request failure rather than degraded reading: above the API’s per-request size cap the call returns no answer and scores zero, and the failure rate climbs from 8 % 8\% in the shortest bin to 68 % 68\% in the longest. Among the requests that do complete, accuracy falls far more gently, from 0.624 0.624 to 0.467 0.467 . Second, every other mode (all-pages images, retrieved images, MinerU text, and the agent) is essentially flat across the four bins, with drops in the range of − 4 -4 to + 1 +1 pp. Selective access modes therefore benefit not only in absolute accuracy but also in stability as document length scales, and the practitioner-facing implication is that any deployment expecting documents above ∼ 80 {\sim}80 pages should avoid raw-PDF input regardless of VLM capability.

blocks.en: The Nem-CE ⊕ \oplus Scout cascade is the best retriever on MMLongBench but trails plain Nem-CE by 11.3 11.3 pp Hit@5 on LongDocURL (§ 4.2 ). Table 9 shows this is a document-length effect. We bin LongDocURL by page count and compute Hit@5 on the answerable subset for both the plain Nem-CE retriever and the Nem-CE ⊕ \oplus Scout cascade. Plain Nem-CE is essentially flat across lengths ( 0.92 0.92 – 0.95 0.95 ), but the cascade degrades with length, from a − 5.7 -5.7 pp deficit on the shortest bin to − 22.0 -22.0 pp on the longest. Plain Nem-CE’s flatness shows the evidence page is still inside the 50 50 -page candidate set at every length, so the loss is in Scout’s final selection: as the candidate set spans a longer document, Scout increasingly ranks the evidence page outside its top five. MMLongBench’s documents are mostly short enough to avoid this regime, which is why the same cascade helps there ( + 2.4 +2.4 pp) and confirms the cross-benchmark asymmetry is a length artifact rather than a benchmark idiosyncrasy.

blocks.en: The main-paper results (Table 1 ) disable the VLM’s reasoning/thinking mode so that all configurations are compared under identical greedy decoding. Table 10 isolates the effect of enabling a reasoning budget before the model answers, holding modality and retrieval depth fixed on MMLongBench-Doc. The sweep covers the two static image modes at three readers; we did not run the function-calling agent or Qwen3.5-27B with a reasoning budget, so no agent row appears here. This is why Table 1 holds every configuration at no-think: it is the only setting in which the agent and the static pipelines have matched decoding. Enabling thinking for the static modes alone would not be like-for-like, and the gap it opens is large enough to matter: Qwen3.5-9B all-images reaches 0.623 0.623 with a reasoning budget, above the 0.616 0.616 of the no-think Qwen3.5-27B agent, but the agent has no corresponding measurement.

blocks.en: Thinking helps five of the six configurations we tested, by about 4 4 to 6 6 pp; the sixth (Qwen3.5-9B on top- k k input, + 2.0 +2.0 pp) has a paired interval that includes zero and we report it as a tie. The gains are largest where the input is largest: both open-weight readers gain more on all-images ( + 5.2 +5.2 pp at 4B, + 6.4 +6.4 pp at 9B) than on top- k k input ( + 4.1 +4.1 and + 2.0 +2.0 pp), which fits the account that a whole-document input leaves more searching for a reasoning budget to do while a top- k k retriever has already localized the evidence. Sonnet gains about 4 4 pp on both inputs. No configuration gains more than about 6 6 pp, and the modality ordering is unchanged in every case, so reporting no-think numbers in the main table does not affect any of our conclusions.
blocks.zh: 思考帮助了我们测试的6个配置中的5个,约4 4到6 6 pp;第6个(Qwen3.5-9B在顶-kk输入,+2.0+2.0 pp)有一个对接间隔,包含0,我们报告为平局. 在输入量最大的地方,收益最大:开放量的阅读器在全像(4B时为+5.2+5.2页,9B时为+6.4+6.4页)上比上-k输入(+4.1+4.1和+2.0+2.0 pp)增加更多,这符合一个说法,即全文件输入值会留下更多的搜索推理预算来完成,而上-k检索器已经将证据本地化. Sonnet在两种投入上获得了大约4-4页. 任何配置增益都不超过6,6pp左右,而且模式顺序在每一种情况下都保持不变,因此在主表中报告无思维数字不会影响我们的任何结论.

blocks.en: We sweep the number of retrieved pages k k for the ColQwen2.5 image retriever across Sonnet and all three Qwen3.5 sizes on both benchmarks (Table 12 ), reporting accuracy and mean input tokens; Full sends the whole document. Accuracy rises steeply to about k = 10 k{=}10 and is flat thereafter: Sonnet peaks at k = 10 k{=}10 and declines by k = 20 k{=}20 as extra pages add distractors, while the Qwen readers gain at most 0.8 0.8 pp between k = 10 k{=}10 and k = 20 k{=}20 for 2 × 2\times the input tokens. Our default of k = 5 k{=}5 sits just below the peak and captures most of its accuracy at roughly half the tokens, which is why we use it throughout. Sending more than about ten pages is not worth the added cost, and even Full (the whole document) never beats the best k k , though for the local Qwen readers on MMLongBench it comes within a point of it. The LDURL Full cell for Qwen3.5-27B is omitted, as is the same configuration’s all-images cell in Table 1 : rendering the uncapped page images of the longest documents did not complete, and an image-size-capped rerun would not be token-comparable to the other cells. This sweep also provides a token-matched control for the agent-versus-static comparison: the k = 20 k{=}20 cells give the static pipeline more input tokens than the corresponding agent consumes, and the agent still leads at Sonnet ( + 11.6 +11.6 pp, significant) though only by + 2.1 +2.1 pp at Qwen3.5-27B, where the interval includes zero (paired tests in § M ), so the agent’s advantage is the access policy rather than the token budget.

blocks.en: Appendix J Agent Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录 J 代理执行细节

blocks.en: This appendix expands the description of the two agentic configurations evaluated in § 4.3 : our six-tool function-calling agent and the ReadAgent baseline.
blocks.zh: 本附录扩展了第4.3节评价的两个代理配置的描述:我们的六工具函数调用代理和ReadAgent基线.

blocks.en: J.1 Six-Tool Function-Calling Agent
blocks.zh: J.1 六工具函数调用代理

blocks.en: The function-calling agent wraps the same VLM used for static configurations in a multi-turn loop. The VLM is given a fixed toolkit and a per-question budget. At each turn it either issues one or more tool calls or commits a final answer via the finish tool.
blocks.zh: 函数调用代理将用于静态配置的相同VLM包在一个多转圈中. 甚高频有一个固定的工具包和每个问题的预算。 每次回合,它要么发出一个或多个工具呼叫,要么通过完成工具作出最后答复。

blocks.en: The agent has access to six tools: • get_catalog returns a deterministic structural map of the document built from MinerU’s per-page layout output, with a per-page index of text size and figure/table counts, a flat section list with title and page range, and flat figure and table lists with captions, inferred neighbor text, and stable integer ids. No LLM is involved in the catalog construction, and the same MinerU output always produces the same catalog. • read_pages(pages, resolution) renders the requested pages as image content blocks at a resolution the model chooses per call: medium (longest side 700 700 px) or full (longest side 1,400 1{,}400 px, rendered at DPI 180). Sonnet 4.5 asks for full on 62 % 62\% of its page reads, Qwen3.5-4B on 68 % 68\% , and Qwen3.5-27B on 12 % 12\% . Multiple pages can be requested in a single call. • get_figure(figure_id) returns the MinerU-extracted figure crop at the given catalog id as an image, plus its caption and neighbor text. Falls back to the full page image when the crop is unavailable. • get_table(table_id) returns the MinerU-extracted table crop, its caption and neighbor text, and the table’s structured HTML. The HTML preserves cell boundaries and is more robust than image-only access for numeric reasoning. • search_text(query, top_k) runs BM25 over MinerU per-page text and returns the top- k k page numbers, each with a matching text excerpt. Used by the VLM as an in-loop retrieval action when it has formed a more specific query than the original question. • finish(answer) commits the final answer and ends the loop.
blocks.zh: 该代理可访问6种工具: 获取_ catalog 返回由 MinerU 每页布局输出构建的文档的定型结构图,其中包含文本大小和数字/表格计数的每页索引,带有标题和页面范围的平面部分列表,以及带有标题的平面图和表格列表,推断出相邻文本,稳定的整数ID. 没有LLM参与目录建设,同样的MinerU输出总是产生相同的目录. • 读取页(页,分辨率)使要求的页成为分辨率的图像内容块,模型选择每个调用:介质(最长侧700,700 px)或完整(最长侧1,400 1{,}400 px,在DPI 180上渲染). Sonnet 4.5在其62%的页面上要求填满,68%的页面是Quen3.5-4B,12%的页面是Quen3.5-27B。 可以在一次呼叫中请求多个页面. • 获得_figure(图_id) 返回给定目录 id 的 MinerU 提取的图裁,加上其标题和相邻文本 。 在无法使用裁剪时, 倒回到整页图像 。 获取列表( table_id) 返回 MinerU 提取的表格裁剪、其标题和相邻文本以及表格的结构化 HTML 。 HTML保存了单元格边界,并且比仅用于数字推理的图像访问更坚固. • 搜索_文本( cry, top_k) 在Miner 上运行 BM25 每页 U 文本并返回上- k k 页码, 每个页码都有匹配的文本节选 。 VLM在形成比原问题更具体的查询时,作为在室检索动作使用. • 完成(回答)承诺最后答案并结束循环。

No LLM is involved in the catalog construction, and the same MinerU output always produces the same catalog.

blocks.en: The catalog is also seeded into the very first user turn alongside the question, so the VLM has the document map without paying a tool-call round-trip, and explicit get_catalog calls are available for re-fetching. Seeding is therefore a latency optimisation rather than a source of the accuracy gain: the same information is reachable by tool call either way, and the agent would simply spend one extra turn retrieving it.
blocks.zh: 该目录也被种子为第一个用户在提问的同时转弯,因此VLM拥有文档映射而无需支付工具调用回路费,并有明确的Geat_catalog调用可供重新调用. 因此,播种是一种暂时的优化,而不是精度增益的来源:同样的信息可以通过工具调用的方式达到,而代理商只需花一个额外的转折检索.

blocks.en: At each turn the VLM sees the conversation so far (including all prior tool returns) and chooses one or more tool calls. We cap the agent at eight tool calls per question. The budget is checked between turns, so a turn that issues several calls in parallel can overshoot it slightly. The Sonnet runner ends the loop at the first finish . For the Qwen3.5 runs the budget is stated in the prompt, the loop is bounded by a hard limit of 20 20 model calls, and it ends when the model returns a turn that issues no tool call: finish records the answer but is itself a tool, so a reader that keeps calling it keeps the loop alive until that ceiling. Qwen3.5-4B exits on its own on 64 % 64\% of questions and exhausts the 20 20 -call ceiling on the other 36 % 36\% ; of those, 97 % 97\% had already emitted finish with an answer. Its call distribution is bimodal, with a median of 5 5 and a spike of 390 390 questions at exactly 20 20 . Qwen3.5-9B and 27B reach the ceiling on 8 % 8\% of questions. This is the cost asymmetry reported in § 4.3 . If the budget is exhausted without a finish , the VLM is given a final turn that must call finish . The temperature is set to zero throughout, and we use each provider’s native function-calling API (the Claude API for Sonnet, and vLLM’s OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with tool schemas for Qwen3.5).
blocks.zh: 在每个转弯时,VLM会看到到目前为止的对话(包括所有先前的工具返回),并选择一个或多个工具调用. 我们每问一个问题 给特工打8个电话 预算是在两个回合之间检查的,因此一个回合同时发出几个电话,可以略微夸大。 Sonnet的跑者在第一回合结束循环 对于Qwen3.5运行预算在即时表示,循环以20个模式调用为硬限制,当模型返回一个发出没有工具调用的转盘时结束:完成记录答案,但本身就是一个工具,所以一个不断调用它的阅读器将循环维持到这个上限. Qwen3.5-4B在64%的问题上单独退出,并在其他36%的36\%上排出20个20的调用上限;其中97%的97\%已经用答案完成。 它的呼叫分布是双模式的,中间数为5 5,突起数为390 390个问题,精确的20 20 . Quen3.5-9B和27B在8%的8QQ问题上达到了上限. 这是第4.3节所报告的成本不对称。 如果预算没有完成就用完了,则VLM得到一个必须称为完成的最后转弯。 温度被设定为0,我们使用每个提供者的本地函数调用API(Claude API for Sonnet,以及vLLM的OpenAI兼容 /v1/chat/完成端点和Quen3.5的工具计).

blocks.en: On MMLongBench-Doc with Claude Sonnet 4.5, the agent averages 2.68 tool calls per question, 20.1 k input tokens (catalog plus tool returns), and 538 output tokens (mostly tool argument JSON plus the final answer). The eight-call budget is rarely exhausted, and the modal trajectory uses two tool calls. We set the cap at eight to leave headroom rather than to constrain the policy, and the observed distribution confirms it does not bind: a cap of six would truncate 3.6 % 3.6\% of trajectories, seven 0.8 % 0.8\% , and eight 0.1 % 0.1\% , while the longest trajectory we observe uses nine calls. Eight therefore sits just past the point where a lower cap would begin to change answers, so the results are insensitive to the exact value.
blocks.zh: 在与Claude Sonnet 4.5的MMLong Bench-Doc上,代理平均每个问题调用2.68个工具,20.1k输入令牌(catalog+工具返回),538个输出令牌(大多是工具参数JSON+最终答案). 八调预算很少用尽,模式轨迹使用两个工具调用. 我们设定上限为8个,以离开头室而不是限制政策,所观察到的分布证实它没有约束:6个上限将截断3.6%的轨迹,7个0.8%的轨迹,8个0.1%的轨迹,而我们观察到的最长的轨迹使用9个调用。 因此,八个国家刚刚过了一个较低上限开始改变答案的点,因此结果对确切值不敏感。

blocks.en: J.2 ReadAgent Baseline
blocks.zh: J.2 读取剂基线

blocks.en: ReadAgent Lee et al. (2024) is a gist-based agent design that we re-implement as the closest published baseline to our toolkit. It pre-computes per-page “gist memories” and lets the VLM iteratively expand the most relevant gists.
blocks.zh: 读取代理 Lee et al. (2024)是一个基于Gist的剂设计,我们重新执行,作为我们工具包最接近公布的基线. 它预先计算每页“吉斯记忆”,让VLM迭代地扩展最相关的吉斯.

blocks.en: For each document, ReadAgent first generates a short gist for every page using a small LLM (Claude Haiku 4.5 in our setup), with a fixed prompt and a 60-word target. At question time, the VLM is shown the full sequence of gists with the question and asked to select the most relevant pages to read in full. The selected pages are rendered at DPI=144 and concatenated with the gists for a final answer turn.
blocks.zh: 对于每个文档,ReadAgent首先会使用一个小的LLM(Claude Haiku 4.5 in our settlement)为每个页面生成一个短的Gist,并有固定的提示和60字的目标. 在提问时,VLM会显示与提问的Gists的完整序列,并要求选择最相关的页面进行全读. 选定的网页在DPI=144上提供,并与gists配合进行最后的答题。

blocks.en: Gist length is capped at 60 words, lookup chooses 1–7 pages (median 2 in our runs), and both gisting and lookup run at temperature zero. Gists are cached on disk per-document and reused across all questions for that document, so the gisting cost amortizes over the full benchmark.
blocks.zh: Gist 长度上限为 60 字, 查找会选择 1–7 页( 中间值 2 in our runs) , 并按 零 温度 进行 。 磁盘上每个文件都缓存Gists,再用于该文件的所有问题,因此,按全部基准摊销成本。

blocks.en: ReadAgent’s lookup operates on LLM-generated gists, which compress each page into 60 words of free-form text, and once pages are selected, no further tool calls happen. Our six-tool agent instead seeds the VLM with a deterministic structural catalog (MinerU-derived section, figure, and table indices) and exposes structured figure-fetch, table-fetch, and BM25 search actions, so the VLM can explore specific structured content rather than committing to a page set up front from compressed text summaries. This difference is reflected in the agentic accuracy gap (§ 4.3 ). ReadAgent’s gist memory loses fine-grained list and table information, while the structural catalog plus targeted tools preserves it.
blocks.zh: ReadAgent的搜索在LLM生成的gists上运行,将每页压缩为自由格式文本的60字,一旦选择页面,就不再出现工具呼叫. 我们的六工具代理用定型结构目录(MinerU衍生的段落,图,和表指数)来种子VLM,并曝光结构化的图谱,表谱,和BM25搜索动作,因此VLM可以探索具体的结构化内容,而不是承诺从压缩的文本摘要前方设置一个页面. 这一差异反映在代理精度差距(第4.3节)。 ReadAgent的gist内存丢失了精细的列表和表格信息,而结构目录加目标工具则保存它.

blocks.en: Both agents run with deterministic decoding ( T = 0 T=0 ). Tool returns are byte-deterministic given the same MinerU output and PDF rendering, and on a fixed VLM checkpoint repeated runs of the same question yield the same trajectory in our spot checks. The MinerU outputs, page renderings, and gist caches are produced once per document and reused across all VLM configurations, so reported per-question latencies reflect agent-loop overhead and not preprocessing time.
blocks.zh: 两个特工都使用定型解码(T=0 T=0)运行. 由于MinerU输出和PDF渲染相同,工具返回是字节决定的,在一个固定的VLM检查点上,同一问题的重复运行在我们抽查中产生相同的轨迹。 MinerU输出、页面渲染和Gist缓存每文档一次,并在所有VLM配置中重复使用,因此,报告的每问题延迟反映了代理-loop的间接费用,而不是预处理时间。

blocks.en: Appendix K Architectural Cost of the Comparison Agents
blocks.zh: 附录K 建筑 比较代理人的费用

blocks.en: Table 13 places the agentic systems of Table 1 on both axes at once, MMLongBench accuracy alongside what each one costs to run. Read together they make the practitioner-facing point of § 4.3 : our agent carries the least machinery of any system in the group, one VLM, a median of two tool calls, and a preprocessing step with no LLM in it, and is nonetheless level with or ahead of every system scored under the official scorer.
blocks.zh: 表13将表1的代理系统一并放在两个轴上,MMLong Bench精确度与每个轴的运行成本并列。 共同阅读它们使第4.3节的实践者-培养点:我们的代理人携带着组内任何系统最小的机械,一个VLM,两个工具呼叫的中位数,以及一个没有LLM的预处理步骤,但是与官方计分器下得分的每个系统处于或领先水平.

blocks.en: Two contrasts carry the cost argument. SimpleDoc keeps two large models in the loop per question, in its published configuration a 30 30 B reasoner driving a 32 32 B answerer over several retrieve-and-refine rounds, where we use a single VLM at 20 20 k input tokens. ReadAgent, the closest gist-based design, spends roughly one Claude Haiku 4.5 call per page to build its gist memory (§ J.2 ), 5,775 5{,}775 calls over the 135 135 MMLongBench-Doc documents, a mean of 43 43 per document, or ∼ 5.3 {\sim}5.3 extra LLM calls per question once amortized over that document’s questions. Our catalog is derived from a single MinerU layout parse with no LLM in the loop.
blocks.zh: 两个对比带有成本论. 简单 Doc在每题循环中保留两个大模型,在其公布的配置中,一个30 30 B的理性器驾驶一个32 32 B的回答器,在几个回放和反射的回合中,我们使用一个20k输入符的单VLM. Read Agent, 最近的基于gist的设计, 大约每页花费1次Claude Haiku 4.5电话来构建其gist内存(§ J.2), 5,775 5{,}775电话在135 MMLong Bench-Doc文档上, 我们的目录来源于一个MinerU布局解析,循环中没有LLM.

blocks.en: Appendix L Tool Usage Analysis for the 6-Tool FC Agent
blocks.zh: 附录 L 6- Tool FC 代理工具的使用分析

blocks.en: To understand which tools contribute most to the 6-tool function-calling agent’s accuracy, we analyze the per-question tool-call traces from the Sonnet 4.5 run on MMLongBench-Doc (N=1,082, mean 2.68 tool calls per question). Table 14 reports how often each tool is invoked, broken down by evidence type.

blocks.en: Table 14: Per-evidence-type tool invocation rates in the Sonnet 4.5 FC agent on MMLongBench-Doc. Values are the percentage of questions for which the agent invoked each tool at least once. The agent reliably routes table-evidence questions to get_table (51%) and chart/figure questions to get_figure (34%/25%), evidence that the structured catalog enables targeted access rather than uniform page reading.

blocks.en: Across 1,082 questions, the median trajectory uses 2 tool calls and the mean is 2.68, with 76% of questions finishing within 3 tool calls and 86% within 4. The full distribution over the number of (non-finish) tool calls is 0 (n=15), 1 (240), 2 (377), 3 (187), 4 (113), 5 (57), 6 (54), 7 (30), 8 (8), 9 (1). Only 3.6% of questions issue more than 6 tool calls, so a tighter 6-call budget would affect very few trajectories and is a defensible cost-saving operating point if a deployment is latency- or cost-sensitive.

blocks.en: Appendix M Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: 附录M 统计 意义

blocks.en: To quantify the uncertainty on Table 1 we bootstrap the per-question scores: for each configuration we resample questions with replacement 10,000 10{,}000 times, under a fixed seed, and take the 2.5 2.5 th and 97.5 97.5 th percentiles of the resampled mean. The resulting 95 % 95\% confidence half-widths are uniform within each benchmark, ± 0.028 \pm 0.028 – 0.030 0.030 on MMLongBench-Doc ( N = 1,082 N{=}1{,}082 ) and ± 0.017 \pm 0.017 – 0.019 0.019 on LongDocURL ( N = 2,325 N{=}2{,}325 ). A useful rule of thumb follows: on these benchmarks a difference below ∼ 3 {\sim}3 pp (MMLB) or ∼ 2 {\sim}2 pp (LDURL) is within single-configuration noise.
blocks.zh: 为了量化表1的不确定性,我们将每个问题的分数固定:对于每个配置,我们用10 000 10{,}000次替换,在一个固定的种子下,再用2.5 2.5 和97.5 97.5 百分位数来重提问题。 结果的95% 95 % 半宽的置信度是每个基准内一致的, ± 0.028\pm 0.028 — 0.030 0 0 030 在MMLong Bench-Doc(N = 1 082 N{=}1{,}082) 和± 0.017\pm 0.017 — 0.019 0.019 在LongDocURL(N = 2 325 N{=}2{,}325) 上。 一个有用的拇指规则如下:在这些基准上,低于 ^ 3 → sim}3 pp(MMELB) 或 ± 2 → sim}2 pp(LDURL) 的区别在单曲噪声内。

blocks.en: We test the paper’s central claims with a paired bootstrap over the questions both configurations answer, resampling the per-question score differences and calling a gap significant when its 95 % 95\% interval excludes zero (Table 16 ). On MMLongBench the headline results are significant: holding the reader fixed, the 6-tool Sonnet agent beats Top-5 ColQwen with the same reader by + 11.7 +11.7 pp, and it also beats the strongest retrieval row at any reader (Top-5 Nem-CE ⊕ \oplus Scout with Qwen3.5-9B) by + 6.1 +6.1 pp, so the lead survives comparison against a stronger reader than its own and not only against a same-reader one. Against the strongest static row overall, all-images with Qwen3.5-27B ( 0.588 0.588 ), the agent leads by + 3.7 +3.7 pp, [ + 0.6 , + 6.8 ] [+0.6,+6.8] . It beats ReadAgent ( + 12.6 +12.6 pp), and the image-over-text retrieval gap (ColQwen over BM25) holds on both benchmarks ( + 10.0 +10.0 / + 8.7 +8.7 pp). On LongDocURL the picture is different: the agent’s + 1.5 +1.5 pp margin over the best static pipeline, Top-5 Nem-CE, has an interval that includes zero, so on that benchmark the two are level and we do not order them. Three further gaps are not significant and we likewise report them as ties: all-images versus MinerU-text on MMLongBench ( − 0.4 -0.4 pp, p = 0.80 p{=}0.80 ), Sonnet versus Qwen3.5-27B as the agent reader ( + 0.9 +0.9 pp), and top- k k retrieval versus all-images at both open-weight readers ( + 2.5 +2.5 and + 0.5 +0.5 pp). The Scout reranker’s effect is significant in both directions: it helps on MMLongBench ( + 2.5 +2.5 pp) and hurts on LongDocURL ( − 2.7 -2.7 pp), confirming the cross-benchmark asymmetry is real and not noise. Likewise the SIRA-versus-single-rerank comparison is a zero-centered tie ( + 0.1 +0.1 pp Hit@5, [ − 2.8 , + 2.9 ] [-2.8,+2.9] against BM25+Cohere; − 0.4 -0.4 pp [ − 3.3 , + 2.6 ] [-3.3,+2.6] against BGE-M3+Cohere), so the two are statistically indistinguishable at our 2 2 pp noise floor and we describe the single rerank as equivalent rather than merely close.
blocks.zh: 我们用双双的靴子来测试论文的核心主张, 在MMLong Bench上,头条成绩是显著的:将读者固定,6工具的索内特代理以+11.7+11.7pp击败同一读者的Top-5 ColQuen,它也以+6.1+6.1pp击败了任何读者最强的检索行(Top-5 Nem-CE ⊕\oplus Scout),因此主角存活下来,比起自己更强的读者,而不只是比起同一读者的一. 与最强的静态行整体对齐,全像与Quen3.5-27B(0.588 0.588 ),剂导比为+3.7+3.7pp,[+0.6,+6.8] [+0.6,+6.8]. 它比ReadAgent (+ 12.6 + 12.6 pp) , 图像翻转文本检索漏洞(ColQuen over BM25 ) 占据了两个基准(+ 10.0 + 0.0 / + 8.7 + 8.7 pp ) 。 在 LongDocURL 上,图片是不同的:代理商在最佳静态管道Top-5 Nem-CE上的比值为1.5+1.5 pp,其间隔包括0,因此在基准上两者是水平的,我们没有命令它们。 还有3个差距并不显著,我们同样将这些差距报告为联系:全景与全景。 MMLong Bench上的MinerU文本( - 0.4-0.4页,p = 0.80 p = 0.80),索内对Quen3.5-27B 作为代理读取器(+ 0.9+0.9 pp),并在两个开量读取器上进行顶-k k检索与全图像(+ 2.5+2.5和+ 0.5+0.5 pp). 童子军的重排效果在两个方向上都很重要:它帮助MMLong Bench(+2.5+2.5pp),并在LongDocURL(−2.7–2.7pp)上伤害,证实跨基准不对称是真实而非噪音. 同样,SIRA-和Single-resrank的比较是0-中心平局(+ 0.1+0.1 pp Hit@5, [− 2.8, + 2.9] [2.8, +2.9] 对 BM25+Cohere; − 0.4-0.4 pp [− 3.3, + 2.6] 对 BGE-M3+Cohere)),因此在统计学上,两者在2pp噪声层上是无法区分的,我们把单一的重新平局描述为等效的,而不仅仅是接近的。

blocks.en: Three of the table’s rows address potential confounds directly. Token matching: the agent’s win is not a budget effect. Static top- k k accuracy peaks near k = 10 k{=}10 and declines at k = 20 k{=}20 as added pages act as distractors (Table 12 ), so a static pipeline given the agent’s token budget or more still loses: the Sonnet agent ( 0.625 0.625 at 20 20 k input tokens) beats static ColQwen k = 20 k{=}20 ( 0.508 0.508 at 27 27 k) by + 11.6 +11.6 pp paired, while the Qwen3.5-27B agent ( 0.616 0.616 at 33 33 k) is only + 2.1 +2.1 pp above its static k = 20 k{=}20 ( 0.595 0.595 at 34 34 k), an interval that includes zero. At Sonnet, then, the advantage is the access policy rather than the compute; at Qwen3.5-27B the two are indistinguishable once tokens are matched. Pure-text evidence: the image-retriever advantage is not only about tables and figures. Restricted to questions whose gold evidence carries no figure, chart, or table (that is, plain-text and layout-bearing text pages only), Nem-CE still beats the best text pipeline (BGE-M3+Cohere) on Hit@5, 0.889 0.889 vs. 0.833 0.833 on MMLongBench and 0.925 0.925 vs. 0.885 0.885 on LongDocURL, so page renderings preserve signal that text extraction loses even for textual evidence, though the margin is smaller than on visual evidence. Extractor bias: scoring raw responses instead of extracted answers under the official scorer costs the static pipelines and ReadAgent 47.1 47.1 – 49.7 49.7 pp (their long-form prose fails string matching, scoring near zero raw) but costs the FC agent only 0.7 0.7 pp ( 0.631 0.631 vs. 0.625 0.625 ), since its finish tool already returns a short structured answer. Table 15 gives the per-system breakdown. The extractor is what makes the baselines’ numbers comparable at all, while for the agent it is a small penalty, so it cannot be inflating the agent’s lead; if anything it understates it.
blocks.zh: 该表的三行直接涉及潜在的混乱。 托肯匹配: 代理商赢不是预算效果 。 静态顶-kk精度峰值接近k = 10 k{=}10,在k = 20 k{=}20,作为添加的页点作用分散(表12),因此由于代理的标语预算或更多还损失了静态管道: Sonnet剂(20 k输入令牌为0.625 0.625)将静态的ColQuen k = 20 k{=}20(27 k为0.508 0.508 +11.6 pp对),而Qwen3.5-27 B剂(33 k为0.616 0.616)仅是+2.1 pp对静态k = 20 k{=}20(34 k为0.595 0.595 +2.1),这一间隔包括零. 在Sonnet,那么优点是访问政策,而不是计算;在Quen3.5-27B,一旦符号匹配,两者是无法区分的. 纯文本证据:图像检索的优势不仅在于表格和数字. Nem-CE仅限于黄金证据没有图、图表或表格的问题(即仅包含纯文本和排版文本页),它仍然在Hit@5、0.889 0.889 vs. 0.833 0.833 vs. MMLong Bench和0.925 0.925 vs. 0.885 0.885 vs. LongDocURL上击败了最好的文本管道(BGE-M3+Cohere),因此页面渲染保留了文本提取即使对文本证据来说也是损失的信号,尽管比在视觉证据上的差幅较小。 提取器偏差:在官方计分器下得分的原始答复而不是提取的答案会花费静态管道和ReadAgent 47.1–49.7 49.7pp(其长式的传言不匹配弦,得分接近0原始),但FC代理只花费0.7pp(0.631 0.631 vs. 0.625 0.625),因为其完成工具已经返回了一个结构短的答案. 表15列出每个系统的细目。 提取器是使基准数完全可以比较的原因,而对于代理人来说,它是一个小的处罚,因此它不能夸大代理人的铅;如果有任何东西它低估了它。

blocks.en: Table 15: Effect of the shared answer extractor on MMLongBench-Doc ( n = 1,082 n{=}1{,}082 ), scoring each system’s raw response and its extracted short answer under the same official scorer. Extraction is part of the benchmark’s own published protocol, and we apply its released prompt unchanged to every system; the near-zero raw column reflects the scorer’s whole-string comparison rather than wrong answers, e.g. for gold “Less well-off” a response containing “…their children will be less well off financially…” scores 0.0 0.0 raw and 0.92 0.92 extracted. Four unrelated baselines are lifted by nearly the same amount because their raw free-form prose scores near zero under string matching; the agent is the only system the extractor does not help, since its finish tool already emits a short structured answer. The protocol therefore favours the baselines and understates the agent’s margin. The extracted column reproduces the corresponding Table 1 cells for all-images, MinerU text, and ReadAgent; the ColQwen row is the k = 5 k{=}5 depth-sweep run of Table 12 , so its gain is computed within that run. The agent’s finish tool already emits a short answer, so its own output stands in for the raw column.
blocks.zh: 表15:共享答案提取器对MMLong Bench-Doc(n=1,082 n{=}1{,}082)的影响,在同一个官方计分器下对每个系统的原始响应及其提取的短答进行评分. 采掘是基准本身公布的协议的一部分,我们对每个系统都采用其释放的速率不变;近零的生列反映了计分员的整弦比而不是错误的答案,例如,对于黄金“Less well-off”,包含“......他们的孩子在经济上将不太富裕......”的回答是0.0 0. 0.0 和0.92 0.92 。 四个不相关的基线被几乎相同的量所解除,因为他们在字符串匹配下原始的自由式传言得分接近0;代理是提取器没有帮助的唯一系统,因为其完成工具已经发出一个结构短的答案. 因此,协议倾向于基线,低估了代理人的比值。 提取的列复制了对应的表1中所有图像,MinerU文本和ReadAgent的单元格;ColQuen行为k = 5 k{=}5 深度擦拭表12,因此其收益是在该运行内计算出来的. 代理的完成工具已经给出了一个简短的答案, 因此它自己的输出代表了原始列 。

A comparison is significant when its 95 % 95\% interval excludes zero; “n.s.” marks gaps within noise that we report as ties, and “equiv.” a zero-centered tie we report as statistical equivalence. blocks.en: Table 1 reports input tokens as the cost axis; Table 17 adds measured per-question wall-clock latency from the logged inference time of each run. The ordering mirrors the token cost but is not identical. Top- k k retrieval is the cheapest mode and among the fastest (median 5.2 5.2 s with Nem-CE and 6.4 6.4 s with ColQwen2.5, against 5.1 5.1 s for ReadAgent’s two-turn lookup), and only image-free MinerU text is faster still (median 3.5 3.5 s), which sends four times the tokens but no images and so skips image decoding entirely; the 6-tool agent is competitive with all-images despite issuing several sequential tool calls (median about 11 11 s), and raw PDF is the slowest (median 12.9 12.9 s on MMLB, 20.5 20.5 s on LDURL) because the API ingests every page as both an image and a text layer. Retrieval’s speed advantage compounds its token advantage: it is roughly 2 × 2\times faster than the agent and 2 2 – 4 × 4\times faster than raw PDF, at about a third of the agent’s input tokens and a tenth or less of raw PDF’s.

blocks.en: These latencies are inference-time only. The one-time preprocessing that retrieval and the agent depend on (MinerU parse, page rendering, index/embedding build, catalog construction) is computed once per document and amortized across every question on that document, which on these benchmarks averages ∼ 8 {\sim}8 questions per document on MMLongBench ( 1,082 / 135 1{,}082/135 ) and ∼ 5.9 {\sim}5.9 on LongDocURL ( 2,325 / 396 2{,}325/396 ). Per-retriever index-build cost is detailed in Table 11 : BM25 indexes in under a second on CPU, and the image retrievers embed a document once on a single A100. The heaviest preprocessing in the table is not ours but the ReadAgent baseline’s, which spends roughly one Claude Haiku 4.5 call per page to build its gist memory (§ J.2 ): 5,775 5{,}775 gisting calls across the 135 135 MMLongBench-Doc documents, a mean of 43 43 per document, or ∼ 5.3 {\sim}5.3 extra LLM calls per question once amortized, roughly 2.7 × 2.7\times its own per-question inference. Our catalog, by contrast, is built from MinerU layout output with no LLM in the loop. Counting preprocessing in would therefore widen our margin over that baseline rather than narrow it. The three access modes differ in what they require offline, which the per-question token column does not show. Raw PDF and all-images need nothing. Top- k k retrieval needs a per-document embedding pass, ∼ 30 {\sim}30 s for ColQwen2.5 and ∼ 45 {\sim}45 s for Nem-CE on one A100 at ∼ 40 {\sim}40 MB per document, and the LLM-based rerank pipelines (SIRA, Nem-CE ⊕ \oplus Scout) additionally spend generative tokens at query time, while the Cohere cross-encoder rerank does not. Our agent needs only the MinerU parse that the text-input modes already require, with no embedding index and no LLM. Amortized over the ∼ 8 {\sim}8 and ∼ 5.9 {\sim}5.9 questions per document these benchmarks provide, none of this reverses the token- or latency-cost ordering, but it does mean the token column understates retrieval’s full cost relative to the agent’s.

blocks.en: This oracle gains roughly 13 13 pp over the best single pipeline, so the pipelines succeed on different questions. Table 1 ’s oracle row, computed over its own common subset, implies + 13.1 +13.1 pp on MMLongBench and + 12.9 +12.9 pp on LongDocURL against the best single pipeline there. We test whether a router conditioned on evidence type can capture this headroom. For every evidence type we identify the pipeline with the highest accuracy on that type, then route each question to its type’s best pipeline; using the gold evidence label makes this an upper bound on any type-conditioned router. Unlike Table 3 , which tags a question with every evidence type its gold pages carry, this analysis assigns each question to a single mutually-exclusive bucket so that a router has exactly one branch to take per question, which shifts the per-type means slightly. The 6-tool agent is the strongest pipeline within every evidence-type stratum on MMLongBench except charts, where ColQwen edges it by 1.5 1.5 pp (e.g. it leads on tables at 0.703 0.703 over MinerU-text at 0.616 0.616 , and on figures at 0.529 0.529 over ColQwen at 0.465 0.465 ), and on LongDocURL for every type except tables, where Top-5 Nem-CE leads by 1.6 1.6 pp, and a 3 3 -question “other” bucket; the type-ceiling router therefore assigns the agent almost everywhere and gains only + 0.2 +0.2 pp on MMLongBench and + 0.6 +0.6 pp on LongDocURL over simply running the agent, both within noise. A realistic router that conditions on observable features (question keywords and answer format, without the gold label) is worse than the agent alone ( − 0.9 -0.9 pp on MMLongBench, − 7.1 -7.1 pp on LongDocURL), since it sometimes routes away from the agent. The oracle headroom is therefore real but intra -type: it lives in disagreements among the pipelines on individual questions of the same evidence type, not in any type-to-pipeline mapping. Recovering it requires a learned per-question router with a finer signal than evidence type, which we leave to future work; a fixed type-based routing rule does not beat a single strong agent. Table 18 summarizes the four strategies.

blocks.en: Appendix P Chunked Map-Reduce for Long Documents

blocks.en: The all-images mode collapses on long documents (§ E ) because the API stitches and downsamples pages once a request exceeds its 100 100 -image/size cap. We test whether this is an artifact of the single-request implementation rather than a limit of the all-images access mode itself, by splitting each long document into contiguous chunks of at most 100 100 pages, answering the question over each chunk independently (rendered at the same 144 144 DPI, 1024 1024 px cap), and then synthesizing a single answer from the per-chunk candidates in a reduce step. We evaluate on the LongDocURL questions whose document has 100 100 pages or more ( 817 817 questions over 115 115 documents, mean 121 121 pages) and score with the same official scorer. The comparison point is plain all-images on the identical subset, which scores 0.204 0.204 (against 0.444 0.444 on the < 100 <\!100 -page subset).
blocks.zh: 全图像模式在长文档(§E)上崩溃,因为API一经请求超过100-100图像/大小封顶,就会缝合和下标页. 我们通过将每个长文件分成最多100页的毗连块,独立地回答每个块的问题(在同一144 DPI, 1024 1024 px 封顶上),然后从每块候选人中合成一个答案。 我们评价LongDocURL问题,其文件有100页或100页以上(817,817个问题超过115个文件,即121,121页),并获得同一官方评分。 比较点是相同子集上的平面全像,该子集的分数为0.2040.204(而在 < 100 QQ!100 - page子集上的0.444 0.444)。

blocks.en: Chunked map-reduce reaches 0.193 0.193 , against 0.204 0.204 for the single-request baseline as scored elsewhere in the paper (§ E ), so the two are a wash and chunking neither helps nor hurts (Table 19 ). Chunking therefore removes the API stitch/downsample without restoring accuracy, and map-reduce remains far below the 0.444 0.444 that all-images achieves on < 100 <\!100 -page documents, so most of the long-document degradation is intrinsic to whole-document image access at this length rather than an artifact of the single request: splitting the document loses the cross-chunk context needed to answer many questions, and the reduce step cannot recover evidence no chunk surfaced. The selective modes (retrieval and the agent), which send only a handful of targeted pages per call regardless of document length, sidestep both failure modes and remain the recommended options on long documents.
